summary: Dashboard UI redesign testing completed - all features verified working. Login, branding, sport cards, active teams with green badges, network section, and bottom navigation all functioning correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard UI completely verified. All badges are GREEN (#4ADE80). All interactive elements working: Football/Futsal cards navigate correctly, team rows clickable, delete modal shows, network expand/collapse works, Add to Network modal opens.

Dashboard top bar.details: Shows 'Demo Coach' name, settings icon (cog-outline), bell/notification icon visible

TACTICAL LINEUP branding.details: Strategy icon (green), 'TACTICAL LINEUP' title, 'FOOTBALL & FUTSAL COACH ASSISTANT' subtitle visible

CREATE NEW SQUAD section.details: Football card (shoe-cleat icon, '5v5 · 7v7 · 9v9 · 11v11') and Futsal card (soccer icon, '5v5') both visible

Football card navigation.details: Clicking Football card navigates to format selection page showing 5v5, 7v7, 9v9, 11v11 options

Futsal card navigation.details: Clicking Futsal card navigates to team setup page with 'FUTSAL · 5v5' badge

MY ACTIVE TEAMS section.details: 4 teams displayed: Storm G14 (9v9, U14), Test England Team (5v5, U12, 🇬🇧), Blitz Futsal (5v5, Senior, 🇩🇪), Ørn FK (11v11, Senior). Each shows: shield with flag, team name, green badges, team code, player/available count

All badges GREEN color (#4ADE80).details: All format badges (5v5, 9v9, 11v11) and age group badges (U12, U14, Senior) are GREEN - no red badges

Team cards clickable and navigate.details: Clicking 'Storm G14' navigates to team page showing sidebar menu, team code, player stats

Delete team icon (trash) present.details: 4 delete buttons found on team rows (trash-can-outline icons)

Delete confirmation modal.details: Clicking trash icon shows modal with red alert icon, 'Delete Team' title, DELETE (red) and CANCEL buttons

MY NETWORK section.details: Visible when scrolling down, shows 'Monolitten 2012' with green badges (U14, 11v11)

Network item expand/collapse.details: Clicking network item shows chevron toggle, expanded state reveals Manager, Phone fields and red 'Remove' button

Add to Network modal.details: Opens modal with green icon, 'Add Team' title, code input field (ABC123 placeholder), 'ADD TO NETWORK' green button, CANCEL button

Bottom navigation bar.details: 4 icons visible: home (green when active), people (account-group-outline), calendar (calendar-outline), globe (web)

Page scrolling.details: ScrollView works - can scroll from teams section down to network section and Add to Network button
